battery/audit/v9/check.py: C4: notes key %r reads as ground truth
battery/metrics/economy.py: Fraction of the run's turns needed to reach 90% of its total cost. Low means the bill settled early.
R^2 of a quadratic fit to context tokens per turn minus R^2 of a linear fit. Positive means context is accelerating.
R^2 of a quadratic fit to prompt size per turn minus R^2 of a linear fit. Positive means what the arm re-reads is accelerating.
Share of total cost spent in the first 25% of turns. High means front-loaded: the arm paid to understand, then coasted.
battery/metrics/epistemic.py: Minimum per-concept compression gain in bits. The statistic K6's mean hides.

the held-out set declares no sampling frame, so this ratio cannot be compared with any other K2 -- a denominator of 3 adversarial gaps and one of 39960 exhaustive cases are different quantities sharing a name
battery/metrics/exploration.py: Distinct states observed. Support for X1/X4, not a ranking.
battery/metrics/mechanism.py: Mean first-use delay for mechanisms met again on a later level — does understanding travel? (Claim C3.)
battery/metrics/planning.py: Actual successful steps divided by the shortest known plan, over runs that reached the goal. 1.0 is optimal; needs ground truth, so development pile and A0 only.
Fraction of environment steps that failed outright. A diagnostic: it is the confound P1 and P2 are most exposed to.
